# Maryam Seyedi · Product Designer & Product Builder

> Portfolio of Maryam Seyedi, a product designer and product builder with 7+ years in design. She works on digital products across EdTech, digital health and SaaS, from research and strategy to interaction design, design systems and AI-assisted prototyping. Based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and open to relocating.

- Current role: Product Designer at Jack Westin (MCAT preparation platform), since 02/2026
- Founder of Homay-nameh, a digital mail club
- Contact: maryamseyedi2002@gmail.com

## Case studies

- [Lila onboarding redesign](https://seyedesign.com/lila): redesigning the onboarding of Lila, an app for women in perimenopause, through an audit, benchmarking and testing with six women.
- [MCAT Hub Calendar at Jack Westin](https://seyedesign.com/jackwestin): designing and launching a calendar that brings study schedules, assignments and live sessions together for MCAT students.
- [Homay-nameh](https://seyedesign.com/homay): a monthly digital letter, two issues and two experiments, with feedback from 17 readers.
- [Top Dogs](https://seyedesign.com/top-dogs): co-founding a product design studio that delivered 12+ digital products for startups.
- [WeFrame](https://seyedesign.com/weframe): founding a design community where junior designers learn on real products.
- [Rubikamp](https://seyedesign.com/rubikamp): designing and teaching a two-year product design course for teenagers.

## Skills

UX research, usability testing, interaction design, design systems, wireframing and prototyping, product strategy, MVP definition, visual design. Tools: Figma, FigJam, Notion, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, PostHog, Claude, ChatGPT, Google AI Studio, Lovable.
